answer: Sybil resistance uses an EigenTrust matrix whose reciprocity-weighted transitivity forms a trust kernel: reputation decays exponentially with a temporal half-life, so only sustained honest service preserves influence. A freshly spawned identity, even in a large sybil garden, has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks credible incoming trust. The resulting score prism exposes this isolation, preventing the identity from passing consensus.
